info.description: The Channel Activity Analysis Review Management API facilitates the submission and management of reviews for banking operational services channel activity analyses. This endpoint allows users to create detailed reviews linked to specific channel activity analysis IDs, enabling enhanced evaluation and oversight of banking operations. Typical consumers include banking analysts and operational managers who analyze channel performance and seek to improve service offerings. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their review processes and ensure high-quality assessments of channel activities.
